title: Project settings
lead: Switch the features of the project on and off here; everything else is in the sections of the menu. What you save here is kept by CONFIG; applications connected over MCP take it themselves.

blocks.note: A change is saved at once.

features.label: Top menu
features.hint: The menu at the top of every page.

guard.title: Switching off the top menu
guard.text: Without the top menu the parts of the project are reachable only by direct links. Remember or copy them before you continue.

features.label: Footer pages
features.hint: Legal and information pages linked from the footer.

features.label: Offline copy
features.hint: Pages a visitor has seen open without a connection.

features.label: Sign-in
features.hint: The sign-in button and the visitor cabinet.

guard.title: Switching off sign-in
guard.text: Without the sign-in button there is no drawer and no way to the architect pages from the site. The parts of the project are reachable only by direct links. Remember or copy them before you continue.

features.label: Breadcrumbs
features.hint: The path to the page above its title.

features.label: Questions and answers
features.hint: The FAQ section on the pages that have it.

features.label: Theme switch
features.hint: Light and dark theme for the visitor.

features.label: Width switch
features.hint: Narrow or wide page for the visitor.

features.label: Language switch
features.hint: The choice of language in the header.

features.label: Social links
features.hint: Links to the project in social networks.

features.label: Screen width badge
features.hint: A small badge with the screen width, for checking layouts.

words.signin: Sign in as the architect of the project to see and change the settings.
words.forbidden: You are signed in, but only the architect of the project can see and change these settings.
words.unavailable: The sign-in service is not answering right now — try again in a minute.
words.error: The settings could not be read. Nothing was changed.
words.savedLive: Saved and sent to the services that follow the settings ({n}). Reload the page to see the change.
words.savedPending: Saved in the project settings. No service is listening right now — each one picks it up at its next start.
words.savedDeploy: Saved. This change takes effect after the next deployment of the project.
words.guardLinks: Direct links to every part of the project:
words.guardNoLinks: The list of the parts of the project could not be read. Do not switch this off until it can.
